limitations: Partial known-positive judgments do not define the full relevant corpus.
No negative course judgments are preconfirmed in this version; a zero false-positive count means no explicitly labeled negatives were returned, not perfect precision.
Unjudged broad, similar-topic and potentially absent-topic cases are independent review probes.
No expected_empty assertion is made without source-wide ground truth.
Recruitment status, personal eligibility, cost and timetable are not established by semantic relevance.
provenance.review_protocol: Review minimal source curriculum evidence against the stated intent before looking at ranks where practical. Add positive/negative labels only with a recorded reason, preserve ambiguous results as unjudged, increment the dataset version, record the new byte hash, and retain earlier artifacts. Never label candidates merely because they were retrieved.
